items.title: Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning

sentences.en: Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning.
sentences.zh: 原始范围请求：无需范围请求调整即可提供大文件。

sentences.en: A video player seeking to the middle of a movie asks for a few megabytes.
sentences.zh: 寻找电影中间的视频播放器要求几兆字节。

sentences.en: Under our old range caching, that one request could make Cloudflare pull 128 MiB from the origin and move it between data centers, sometimes after the viewer had already left.
sentences.zh: 在我们的旧范围缓存下，一个请求可以使Cloudflare从源中提取128 MiB并在数据中心之间移动，有时在观众已经离开之后。

sentences.en: Range requests are how large files get delivered, and caching them naively easily leads to wasted network bandwidth and wasted disk operations when running a CDN at scale.
sentences.zh: 范围请求是交付大文件的方式，在大规模运行CDN时，天真地缓存它们很容易导致浪费网络带宽和浪费磁盘操作。

sentences.en: So we rebuilt how our cache handles them.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们重建了缓存处理它们的方式。

sentences.en: For R2, Cloudflare's object storage, p99 time to first byte dropped by about half, and a follow-up improvement cut tiered cache traffic for R2 and similar workloads by about 6%.
sentences.zh: 对于R2 ， Cloudflare的对象存储， p99到第一个字节的时间减少了大约一半，后续改进将R2和类似工作负载的分层缓存流量减少了大约6%。

sentences.en: Today, we're making that new implementation available as Origin Range Requests , a self-service feature on all plans.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将该新实现作为Origin Range Requests提供，这是所有套餐的自助服务功能。

sentences.en: There's no range size to tune and no need to contact support.
sentences.zh: 无需调整范围大小，也无需联系客服。

sentences.en: Turn it on with a Cache Rule , and Cloudflare handles the rest.
sentences.zh: 使用缓存规则将其打开， Cloudflare将处理其余部分。

sentences.en: A request for part of a file An HTTP range request asks for part of a resource instead of the whole resource.
sentences.zh: 对文件的一部分的请求HTTP范围请求请求的是资源的一部分，而不是整个资源。

sentences.en: The client sends a normal GET with a Range header: GET /movie.mp4 HTTP/1.1 Host: example.com Range: bytes=1048576-2097151 If the server supports the request, it returns 206 Partial Content and identifies the returned bytes with Content-Range : HTTP/1.1 206 Partial Content Content-Range: bytes 1048576-2097151/524288000 Content-Length: 1048576 Range requests are common for large objects.
sentences.zh: 客户端发送带有Range标头的正常GET ： GET/movie.mp4 HTTP/1.1 Host: example.com Range: bytes = 1048576-2097151如果服务器支持该请求，它将返回206 Partial Content ，并使用Content-Range: HTTP/1.1 206 Partial Content Content-Range: bytes 1048576-2097151/524288000 Content-Length: 1048576标识返回的字节。对于大型对象，范围请求很常见。

sentences.en: A video player can request bytes around a seek position instead of the whole file.
sentences.zh: 视频播放器可以请求查找位置周围的字节，而不是整个文件。

items.title: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management

sentences.en: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management.
sentences.zh: 将后量子密码学引入地理围栏密钥管理。

sentences.en: Today, Cloudflare is launching a post-quantum geographically restricted key manager in support of our Data Localization Suite (DLS) in closed beta.
sentences.zh: 今天， Cloudflare将推出后量子地理限制密钥管理器，以支持我们的数据本地化套件(DLS)的封闭测试版。

sentences.en: This new PQ GeoKey Manager is a cornerstone of Cloudflare’s data sovereignty solutions, making sure that a customer's decryption keys are only accessible in their chosen geography.
sentences.zh: 这款新的PQ GeoKey Manager是Cloudflare数据主权解决方案的基石，可确保客户的解密密钥只能在其选择的地理位置访问。

sentences.en: GeoKey Manager implements this by wrapping each decryption key such that it can only be decrypted by Cloudflare servers that are located in the allowed geography.
sentences.zh: GeoKey Manager通过包装每个解密密钥来实现这一点，使其只能由位于允许地理位置的Cloudflare服务器解密。

sentences.en: While general availability (GA) is planned for Q1 2027, today’s launch is an important milestone on our journey to support our customers’ data sovereignty goals while also migrating all Cloudflare products to post-quantum (PQ) cryptography .
sentences.zh: 虽然计划在2027年第一季度全面上市（ GA ） ，但今天的发布是我们支持客户数据主权目标之旅中的一个重要里程碑，同时也将所有Cloudflare产品迁移到后量子（ PQ ）加密。

sentences.en: Governments, financial institutions, healthcare providers, and defense organizations process highly sensitive data that can remain sensitive for years or decades after it is produced.
sentences.zh: 政府、金融机构、医疗保健提供商和国防组织处理高度敏感的数据，这些数据在生成后可以保持敏感数年或数十年。

sentences.en: Encryption is often required to protect this data.
sentences.zh: 通常需要加密来保护这些数据。

sentences.en: When classical, public-key encryption is used, adversaries do not immediately need a quantum computer today to put that data at risk: they can store the ciphertext and retain them until quantum computers can break the public key cryptography protecting it — an attack strategy known as harvest now, decrypt later.
sentences.zh: 当使用经典的公钥加密时，对手现在并不需要量子计算机来将数据置于风险之中：他们可以存储密文并保留它们，直到量子计算机可以破解保护它的公钥加密—这种攻击策略称为现在收获，稍后解密。

sentences.en: For organizations with geographic requirements, resisting that threat is only half the challenge.
sentences.zh: 对于具有地域要求的组织来说，抵御这种威胁只是挑战的一半。

sentences.en: At Cloudflare's scale, high availability requires replicating customer data across many servers across our global network.
sentences.zh: 按照Cloudflare的规模，高可用性需要在我们全球网络中的许多服务器上复制客户数据。

sentences.en: However, many data sovereignty regulations require that certain types of data be processed only within a given geographical region.
sentences.zh: 但是，许多数据主权法规要求仅在给定地理区域内处理某些类型的数据。

sentences.en: We must therefore ensure the data is end-to-end encrypted such that only servers within the region have access to the plaintext.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们必须确保数据是端到端加密的，只有区域内的服务器才能访问明文。

items.title: Duchess of Sussex ‘deeply distressed’ over child sexual abuse image claims against father

sentences.en: Duchess of Sussex ‘deeply distressed’ over child sexual abuse image claims against father.
sentences.zh: 苏塞克斯公爵夫人对针对父亲的儿童性虐待形象索赔“深感痛苦”。

sentences.en: Meghan reveals she was made aware of ‘disturbing allegations’ against him in 2018 by Met police The Duchess of Sussex has said she is “deeply distressed” over accusations involving child sexual abuse images against her estranged father, Thomas Markle Sr, and revealed she was made aware of “disturbing allegations” against him in 2018 by the Metropolitan police.
sentences.zh: 梅根透露，她在2018年被大都会警察局告知对他的“令人不安的指控”苏塞克斯公爵夫人表示，她对涉及对她疏远的父亲托马斯·马克尔（ Thomas Markle Sr ）的儿童性虐待图像的指控“深感悲痛” ，并透露她知道大都会警察局在2018年对他的“令人不安的指控”。

sentences.en: Meghan issued a statement after the Sun newspaper published claims that her half-brother Thomas Markle Jr alleged he had found a stash of images belonging to their father at his former home in the Philippines.
sentences.zh: 梅根在《太阳报》发表声明后发表声明称，她的同父异母兄弟小托马斯·马克尔（ Thomas Markle Jr ）声称，他在他们父亲在菲律宾的前家中发现了一些属于他父亲的照片。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读
